name: Firstmen Warriors
_source: Monster Sheet (2 pages), AI/BP/Battle Tactics card sheet, Signature — owner scans 2026-11-15 (readings owner-confirmed); Clash Setup: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.46–47

footprint.rear: the cell directly behind (R / eye on the sheet diagram = Rear + Blindspot)

basicAbilities.name: Advanced Bypass
basicAbilities.rule: Rulebook p.80: may move through other miniatures; cannot end on one.

basicAbilities.name: Blindspot
basicAbilities.rule: The space behind each Warrior is a Blindspot: Knights there are not in sight and gain +1 Precision.

basicAbilities.name: Immediate Spawn
basicAbilities.rule: Rulebook p.62 + Mangrove Deployment: a killed Warrior is replaced at once (BP one level higher) on a Great Mangrove tile, cycling 1→2→3.

traits.name: Battle Tactics
traits.text:
Additional Setup: Draw one Battle Tactics card.
Tactics X: Add the effect corresponding to given Tactic A and Tactic B on the Battle Tactics card.

traits.name: Mangrove Deployment
traits.text:
When you kill a Firstman Warrior, immediately Spawn a new one on the Great Mangrove Terrain tile, starting with location number 1 (see Clash Diagram), then going clockwise.

Treat all Firstmen Warriors on Great Mangrove Terrain tiles as if they weren’t on the Clash Board. They cannot be attacked, activated, or affected in any way until they leave those tiles.

At the End of Knight Round: All Firstmen Warriors on Great Mangrove Terrain tiles, starting from the Mob with the lowest number, move adjacent to those tiles, onto the closest possible space to any Knight.

traits.name: Long Howl
traits.text: If any effect triggers Long Howl, Spawn the White Ape Troll in the center of the Clash Board (Displace any miniatures if needed), then turn it to face the most Knights. If this effect would trigger when the Ape Troll is already on the Clash Board, ignore it. The Ape Troll uses Firstman Warrior attributes. Look for BP 2 Muscular Chest and AI 2 Rampage Strike from the Ape Troll’s decks and place them revealed next to the Clash Board. Never discard or Escalate these cards. The Ape Troll activates after Firstmen Warriors and performs Rampage Strike. When you attack the Ape Troll, you always target the Muscular Chest BP. When you wound that BP, Escalate the Firstmen Warriors AI deck, then place a Generic token on the BP and place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack. If there are 4 Generic tokens on the BP, the White Ape Troll will flee from the Clash. Remove it from the Clash Board.

traits.name: Show of Strength
traits.text: Start of Monster Round: Reveal the leftmost unrevealed BP card on the Mob track.

traits.name: Retribution
traits.text: When the fourth BP card goes into the Wound Stack, after you finish resolving the current action, trigger the Long Howl Trait and activate the White Ape Troll.

traits.name: Keeping Up the Pressure
traits.text: When a Knight performs a Full Evade or reduces [Vigor] loss from an AI to 0, after you finish resolving the current AI, the next Monster on the Mob track performs Signature against that Knight.

clashSetup._source: Sunken Kingdom Codex p.46–47 (Firstmen Warriors Clash)
steps: Monster Positioning: Randomly place Firstmen Warrior miniatures numbered 1–6 on the designated spaces (facing per arrows). Then place 6 BP 1 cards face down in a random order on spaces 1–6 of the Mob track.
Additional Setup: Follow Trait instructions (Battle Tactics: draw one Battle Tactics card). Set aside all Battle Tactics cards not used in this Clash.

rulings: Tactic A/B lines resolve in card order on a hit, using the drawn Battle Tactics card with X = the printed number; on BP Fail responses they target the Attacker (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
Tactics Target = the Battle Tactics card's targeting line (Closest non-Engaged / Closest Lone / Closest Grouped Knight)
Predator Tactics "Lone Knights additionally lose -2 Vigor" applies to every Firstmen Attack that causes Vigor loss to a Lone Knight (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Mangrove Deployment: the new Warrior (BP one level higher, leftmost empty track space) waits on the Mangrove tile — off the Clash Board — until the End of the Knight Round, then moves adjacent to that tile onto the free space closest to any Knight (lowest number first)
RANGE ATTACK UNLIMITED: no movement; any Knight in sight can be targeted
LAND ON TOP: the Warrior moves onto the Target's space, the Target is Displaced to a front space; the Zone is the card diagram around the Warrior
Iron Rain "every Mob adjacent to the Attacker": Mobs adjacent to the attacking Warrior (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)

Long Howl (소유자 확인 2026-11-15: wounding the Troll escalates the lowest AI): the White Ape Troll (2x2) Spawns on the centre (F7/F8/E7/E8, Displacing miniatures), faces the most Knights, uses the Firstmen To Hit/AT/Vigor bonuses, activates after the Warriors each Monster Round with Rampage Strike; Knights attacking it always hit Muscular Chest; wounding it Escalates the Firstmen AI deck, adds a Generic token and a Single Wound to the Wound Stack; 4 tokens → it flees
Rampage Strike "MOVE, PUSHBACK 3 & ATTACK": after moving, Pushback 3 before the Evasion Roll; the attack then resolves against that Target (소유자 확인 2026-11-15)
"When X attacks, add its Instinct Response to the After Attack": the revealed BP3 Warrior's own Instinct Response is resolved against its Target after its attacks
